answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent earns only after trading with at least 12 distinct counterparties in an epoch — a real lotus of varied partners, each with its own pigment, not one cloned inlet feeding the same wallet. A farm with 100 clones needs 1,200 genuine counterparties, each fake edge costing a real fee; clones cannot count for each other. Honest agents trade widely and pay nothing extra; a clone costs more than it earns.
